_doc: Gaps of scripts/cmux-next/every-action-gaps.json the browserProfile fixture (scripts/cmux-next/oracle/action_fixtures/browser_profile.py) closes, each with how. p15-oracle-087 applies every gap-closures file to every-action-gaps.json in one edit; action_fixtures.load_families refuses a CLOSES that differs from `closed`.

closed.browserProfile.duplicateTab: browserProfile: the scratch profile; PREPARE opens the browser tab it duplicates (both close as extras)
closed.browserProfile.manageExtensions: browserProfile: the scratch profile; its extensions page opens as an extra tab
closed.browserProfile.moveTab: browserProfile: the scratch profile; PREPARE opens the browser tab it moves (an extra), the base's tabs keep their profile
closed.browserProfile.newTab: browserProfile: the scratch profile; the new tab is an extra
closed.browserProfile.newWindow: browserProfile: the scratch profile; the new window is an extra
closed.browserProfile.newWorkspace: browserProfile: the scratch profile; the new workspace is an extra
closed.browserProfile.openLink: browserProfile: the scratch profile, url: about:blank; the new tab is an extra
closed.browserProfile.setSpaceDefault: browserProfile: the scratch profile; UNDO runs browserProfile.clearSpaceDefault
closed.browserProfile.setWorkspaceDefault: browserProfile: the scratch profile; UNDO runs browserProfile.clearWorkspaceDefault
